tagline: 柯达盒式相机，1888 年发布
description: 柯达于1888年推出的盒式相机。配备Bausch & Lomb 57mm f/9 Rapid Rectilinear wide angle lens。快门速度string set; cylindrical (Kodak), sector 'T' and 'I' shutter (Kodak No.1)。使用paper rolls - changed by manufacturer, alternate loading with transparent film (only Kodak No. 1)。

specs.胶片/画幅: paper rolls - changed by manufacturer, alternate loading with transparent film (only Kodak No. 1)
specs.镜头: Bausch & Lomb 57mm f/9 Rapid Rectilinear wide angle lens
specs.快门: string set; cylindrical (Kodak), sector 'T' and 'I' shutter (Kodak No.1)
specs.英文简介: The Kodak is George Eastman's legendary first rollfilm camera bearing the new brand name "Kodak", patented and introduced in 1888.
